title: AI agents are coming to Rivian’s cars
slides: Rivian's cars gain AI agents—will they put drivers on autopilot?
The new software layer aims to understand natural language commands.
But it will predict your needs before you even ask.
Your next Rivian could plan routes and charge stops autonomously.
So, when your car thinks ahead, who's really in control?
thread_text:
1. Who's driving your Rivian?

Rivian's new AI agents can interpret natural language and predict your needs before you ask. The car is starting to think for itself.

2. The car that listens

A new software layer aims to understand commands like "find a charger" without you touching a screen. It's not just voice control—it's comprehension.

3. Anticipating your every move

This system doesn't just respond—it predicts. It might suggest a charge stop before you realize you need one, based on your route and driving history.

4. From assist to autopilot

Your next Rivian could plan routes and charge stops autonomously. That's a shift from driver assistance to full trip management.

5. Are you ready to let go?

When your car thinks ahead, who's really in control? Test it yourself: next time you drive, notice how many decisions you'd hand over.
